description: This file defines and exports functions related to plugin SDK entry points, including building source paths, specifiers, export mappings, and listing distribution artifacts. It references a JSON file for plugin entry names.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Constructs an object mapping each plugin SDK entry to its source file path.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Generates an array of import specifiers for plugin SDK entries, with special handling for 'index'.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Creates a mapping from package export paths to corresponding type declaration and JavaScript files.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of distribution artifact paths (.js and .d.ts) for all plugin SDK entries.
